description: RTS Ridership - by route, by month is a dataset listed in City of Gainesville open data portal (data.cityofgainesville.org), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Gainesville. Regional Transit System (RTS) Ridership data, by route, by month. Coverage: Gainesville, Florida. The portal files it under the category Mobility. Its tags are transit. The table has 7 columns. Attribution on the portal: Regional Transit System (RTS). The portal shows 2022-11-30 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-cityofgainesville-org-portal.
